messages:
michelle: Quick idea 10 for tacos + trivia at La Taqueria (loud, spicy) or 20 for boba + board games at The Den (cozy). Time options: 6pm or 7:30pm. Drop votes and any food restrictions.

aj: 1 for tacos. 6pm works. Can bring napkins and a pack of hot sauce packets :taco:

samir: 2 please. need a quieter place to actually talk. 7:30 is safer for me.

claire: 2! Ill bring a tiny travel speaker and some napkins. If we do trivia, we should reserve a table.

natalie: 2 and Ill bring Azul and Coup. allergy: cilantro (avoid).

leo: leaning 1 but will go with the majority. can scout The Den for couches.

riley: 2 and prefer earlier if possible 1: 6:30 would be perfect.

pollbot: Poll started: Option 1  Tacos + Trivia; Option 2  Boba + Board Games. Time choices: 6pm, 6:30pm, 7:30pm. Poll auto-closes in 12h.

michelle: Looks like board games are ahead. Proposed plan: meet at The Den at 6:30pm, folks who want tacos can head over after. Leo/natalie can you try to save a corner? If not, well aim for 6:15 to claim seats.

leo: Ill drop off jackets to save two couches and DM the host. If the Den says no, Ill post here.

aj: If anyone wants a late taco run after, Im in. cash is fine.

claire: Ill get a short snack rota: small things only. volunteer list in replies.

michelle: Allergies: natalie cilantro, riley dairy-free. anyone else?

samir: none.

riley: noted re dairy-free. thanks.

michelle: Pollbot update: 2 (Boba + Board Games) 5 votes, 1 (Tacos + Trivia) 3 votes. Time majority: 6:30pm. Locking plan.

pollbot: Poll closed. Final: Boba + Board Games at The Den, 6:30pm.

michelle: RSVP thread: michelle (yes), aj (yes, might taco after), samir (yes), claire (yes), natalie (yes), leo (yes), riley (yes). Ill pin the address tomorrow and share a tiny map. See you Wed :boba::game_die:
